verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's own homepage describes a case platform for uploading documents and "tracking what is ready," which is a first-party case-tracking surface. Candidate Progress Reports are also listed on the Plus tier. Beyond that, the evidence never describes a client portal or dashboard that shows case status and next steps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a client portal or dashboard view, case status stages, next-step guidance in the interface, screenshots or product docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product

citations.quote: Our platform simplifies every step of your case preparation, from uploading documents to tracking what is ready.
